verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a company-formation and compliance SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The "AI-powered, human-managed bookkeeping" and "bookkeeper live chat" items describe a back-office bookkeeping service with a human chat contact, which is an adjacent feature rather than an assistant. The "we handle it on your behalf" claims describe human-performed services.
